conditions.evidence: computer vision models for diabetic retinopathy
conditions.label: diabetic retinopathy

modalities.evidence: retinal fundus photos captured via portable cameras
augmented with clinical and demographic metadata

output.population: 5164 images from 1291 patients diagnosed with diabetes, of diverse ethnic backgrounds, in Itabuna, Bahia
output.summary: Retinal images captured with portable handheld cameras alongside clinical and demographic metadata, intended for developing and validating algorithms for portable retinal cameras and diabetic retinopathy detection.
